title: dela
intro: Dela, commonly known as Clerodendrum infortunatum, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the management of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Dela are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dela include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
